note: Kelly-standard candidate cards (2b): photo, a short bio in the candidate's own site's words, and published contact — each read from the cited page on the date recorded, every photo URL HEAD-verified as an image. Photo rule for challengers (author-adjusted): a challenger has no official portrait, so the campaign site's own photo is the legitimate source — recorded and labeled as such. Bios are the site's words, attributed, never our characterization. A candidate without an entry still renders a card (name, party, links, reaction control); every bio/photo absence is a recorded hunt below, never a blank presented as a fact.
